text:
Situation: Hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 231 tablets at 11.6 tablets per day (19.9 days on hand). Corvale General holds 262 tablets at 13.8 tablets per day (19 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 98 tablets (26.9 days on hand). Combined supply across sites is approximately 20 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include hydrochlorothiazide as of 2026-10-21. The label for NDC 51655027226 names Northwind Health Company, LLC as labeler and plant (FEI 1831143) with a VAI inspection on 2025-09-26. That plant, Northwind Pharmaceuticals LLC, received an OAI classification on 2015-12-09 and VAI classifications on 2015-09-14, 2018-11-16, and 2025-09-26.

Our position: Current inventory provides roughly 20 days of supply at the two highest-use sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Accord Healthcare Inc. as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Actavis Pharma, Inc. and Aurobindo Pharma Limited as secondary sources; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Chartwell RX, LLC and Exelan Pharmaceuticals Inc. for additional supply redundancy; requires buyer approval.
4. Pharmacy director to monitor daily burn rates at all three sites and report to P&T committee weekly; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No formulary changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
